name: handle_new_user
purpose: Create profiles row for every new auth user (incl. anonymous)

name: create_household
signature_or_route: create_household(p_name text, p_language text, p_members jsonb) returns jsonb
purpose: Create household, owner member, profiles, default locations and list in one transaction
writes: households, household_members, voice_profiles, taste_profiles, storage_locations, shopping_lists

name: add_inventory_items
signature_or_route: add_inventory_items(p_household uuid, p_items jsonb, p_added_via text) returns uuid[]
purpose: Insert items with estimated expiry and log events

name: finish_inventory_item
signature_or_route: finish_inventory_item(p_item uuid, p_discarded boolean) returns void
purpose: Mark finished/discarded with event

name: get_use_soon
signature_or_route: get_use_soon(p_household uuid, p_days int) returns table
purpose: Items expiring within p_days, ordered by days left

name: get_voice_context
signature_or_route: get_voice_context(p_household uuid, p_member uuid, p_session uuid) returns jsonb
purpose: Build the voice agent context packet
reads: voice_profiles, household_members, taste_profiles, inventory_items, memories, cooking_sessions, recipe_steps, recommendations

name: search_recipes
signature_or_route: search_recipes(p_query text, p_limit int) returns setof recipes
purpose: Trigram search over titles and tags in any spelling

name: start_cooking_session
signature_or_route: start_cooking_session(p_household uuid, p_recipe uuid, p_servings int, p_who uuid[], p_mode text, p_recommendation uuid) returns uuid
purpose: Create session; mark pick accepted; abandon older active sessions

name: advance_session_step
signature_or_route: advance_session_step(p_session uuid, p_delta int, p_event text, p_channel text) returns jsonb
purpose: Move step pointer (bounded), log event, return the step

name: complete_cooking_session
purpose: Mark complete and return deduction preview scaled by servings

name: apply_session_deduction
signature_or_route: apply_session_deduction(p_session uuid, p_adjustments jsonb) returns int
purpose: Apply (corrected) deduction to pantry with events

name: submit_feedback
signature_or_route: submit_feedback(p_session uuid, p_member uuid, p_rating text, p_tags text[], p_comment text, p_make_again boolean) returns jsonb
purpose: Store feedback; nudge taste dials; return memory candidates

name: save_memory
signature_or_route: save_memory(p_household uuid, p_member uuid, p_statement text, p_category text, p_scope text, p_source text, p_polarity int, p_attributes jsonb, p_subject_ingredient uuid, p_provenance jsonb) returns uuid
purpose: Save memory; corrections supersede conflicting memories on the same subject

name: forget_memory
purpose: Mark forgotten (hard delete by retention job after 30 days)

name: confirm_memory
purpose: Keep: raise confidence, set last_confirmed_at

name: add_to_shopping_list
signature_or_route: add_to_shopping_list(p_household uuid, p_items jsonb) returns uuid[]
purpose: Add items to the active list, merging duplicates

name: mark_list_items_bought
purpose: Mark bought and add to pantry

name: private.decay_inventory_confidence
purpose: Lower confidence by age and state; flag expired

name: private.retention_cleanup
purpose: Delete forgotten memories > 30 days, utterances > 30 days, abandoned sessions, old finished items

name: private.abandon_stale_sessions
purpose: Mark sessions idle > 24 h as abandoned

name: parse-inventory
purpose: Natural-language pantry text → structured items

name: suggest-meals
purpose: Candidate retrieval, deterministic scoring, model-written reasons

name: adapt-recipe

name: checkpoint

purpose: Delete account and sole-owner households

purpose: Daily pick and Use Soon pushes with cap and quiet hours
